test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters A, B, C, P, Q and R are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ac08e3fac85bee591d0f94cb558493d70e86b52a5dd46d32a016e1c59b7ac61.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As P is common on both the dices, it is clear that A, B, C, and R are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. Q will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/632f4e136299ac27cfce62aa037f5ed7d3f21a3f003333c72ed710aae36e968c.png] 

Opposite pairs:

B → R

A → C

P → Q

So, the opposite side of "B" will be side "R".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
